title: Flutter Team Shares the Next Performance Roadmap
summary: New rendering and tooling work targets smoother apps.

body.text: The roadmap focuses on startup time, frame consistency, and a leaner build pipeline for large applications.
Rendering work targets fewer dropped frames on mid-range devices, while new tooling surfaces jank before it ships.

body.caption: Rendering pipeline overview shared by the team.

body.text: Developers can try preview builds on the beta channel, with stable releases expected over the coming quarters.
